name: A Short Hike: Collector's Edition
summary:
The Collector's Edition of the game A Short Hike comes in a collector's edition cardboard box in a limited quantity of 2.000 pieces and includes:

The game A Short Hike
46-page retro style guidebook of Hawk Peak
4 sticker sheets of the Flora and Fauna found on Hawk Peak
A poster-sized retro style fold-out map of Hawk Peak
A pocket-sized mini map of Hawk Peak
A set of 3 postcards
A pin badge of the protagonist Claire
The official soundtrack (2 CD's in a digipak)
Exclusive sticker.
A complete art card set (5 pieces).
